title: Rail: the whole map always in view
axis: fixed left sidebar of every section and page (all open), wide reading column, sticky in-page table of contents on the right for long pages; phone: rail becomes a menu sheet, table of contents a disclosure
worse_at: Least focused reading of the three: 520 px of chrome flanks the text. The 30-entry rail is taller than a screen, so the lower sections need a rail scroll, and switching sections is a scroll, not a click. Crowded between 1024 and 1280 px. On the phone, its main value (seeing where you are) hides behind the Menu button. Search lives in the rail, not in a dominant spot.
